paper_title: Production of dark matter axions from collapse of string-wall systems
notes: Theory/cosmology paper. Performs 3D lattice field-theory simulations of the PQ field to compute the relic abundance of cold dark matter axions from vacuum misalignment, global string decay, and string-wall (domain wall) network collapse (N_DW=1). The headline result is a cosmological upper bound on the axion decay constant from requiring the total axion relic abundance not exceed Omega_CDM h^2 = 0.11: F_a <~ (2.0-3.8)x10^10 GeV (Eq. 96), i.e. m_a ~ 10^-3 - 10^-2 eV. This is a theoretical cosmological overclosure constraint, not an experimental or observational exclusion on any of the couplings in the canonical table (no coupling-vs-mass exclusion curve). Not a projection/sensitivity forecast either. Hence is_new_limit=false, no data points to report.
